subject: Energy unit conversions used in the household-energy study

finding.claim: 1 kWh is 3.6 MJ. EIA gives propane 91,452 Btu per gallon; at 1 Btu = 1,055.06 J that is about 96.49 MJ per gallon. KCAL converts as exactly 4,184 J. Diesel, cordwood and household heating needs each take their own declared factor and quantity. A joule figure names the receipts and conversion factors it includes.

method: Reading of the cited sources on 2026-09-05, carried into this record on 2026-10-30 from the September 19 note.
